reports.title: Announces Dividend Distribution of $10 Million for the Third

desk.headline: Revenue up 15% to $106.6m, above estimates; EPS of $0.91 slightly below; no numerical guidance
results: Revenue rose 15% to $106.6m, above the $104.7m estimate; diluted EPS of $0.91 (+23%) was just below the $0.94 estimate.
Subscription revenue grew 19% to $80.5m on subscriber growth in Israel and Latin America and OEM programmes; product sales rose 5%.
Profit grew faster than sales: operating income +29% to $25.4m (23.8% margin) and net income +23% to $18.0m.
Ituran added 40,000 net subscribers but removed 67,000 low-revenue US subscribers after a customer's bankruptcy, ending at 2.68m.
Operating cash flow was $25.3m and net cash $107.6m with no debt; it bought back $1.9m of shares and declared a $0.50 dividend.

guidance.summary: Ituran gives no numerical guidance. Management said it expects further revenue growth and higher profitability, and put the impact of the removed US subscribers at about $1m of 2027 revenue.

call.source: No call coverage found; tone based on Co-CEO Eyal Sheratzky's comments in the press release (Exhibit 99.1)
